author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#writingcommunity

Watching Terrence,
George Floyd's
    brother
crumble on
   sacred ground
atop the spot
  of murder
chants of "Take a Knee"
 calling us to action
for the
  eight minutes
whn the knee
   of racism
ground into
George's throat
while three police officers
stood there, doing
   nothing
brought tears
of anger
mixing with compassion
and prayer
   Doing nothing
we have done nothing for
long
Everyone needs to
take a knee
